scope: Small code/generated review only of the explicit new V95 protected-union adapter. No repeat of the full V3 kernel review and no actual source donor/image/feature feasibility claim.

closed_physical_uncertainty_endpoints.formula: For closed [lo,hi], nearest-cell indices are floor(lo+.5) through floor(hi+.5), inclusive; no clipping or coordinate movement.

all_disjoint_retained_regions.definition: Iterates every supplied PALLOX_CLOSED_NATIVE_UNCERTAINTY bbox into a boolean union; keeps the gap between disjoint boxes false. Reordering regions has identical mask. Any invalid retained region yields whole pair U; it is not skipped.
all_disjoint_retained_regions.upstream_boundary: Completeness of protected_regions_GT_only against every retained_FULL_GT_cues remains a saved-metadata driver check.

LOCO_convention_unchanged.definition: Delegates to pinned V3 controlled_protected_support and its original half-open pixel-edge convention; no common coercion to Pallox closed ranges.

pinned_geometry_mass_compositing_unchang.definition: Adapter pins V3 SHA, which pins V2/V1; calls existing V2 support_scaled_cutout/core_aligned_pair/mass_certificate and V1 compose directly. Invented adapter results equal direct helper outputs and facts. No monkeypatch or source-helper modification.

labels_natural_E20.definition: Adapter computes geometry/images/certificate only and writes no canonical label array. V3 decision_identity still accepts D/U only. Natural E construction decisions are rejected; V95 driver must supply those20 as noneligible construction U and keep canonical BEFORE E separately. No natural E overwrite is introduced by this adapter.

two_sided_failure_and_mass.definition: On infeasible geometry/donor/mass, adapter returns no pair; it does not invent after labels, retry a donor or weaken mass thresholds. Successful cover alpha is1 on entire union; sham alpha0 and protected source RGB unchanged.

limitations: The original physical uncertainty boxes are conditional AI source annotations, not separate physical support polygons or native expected-part gold.
Generated union coverage is not actual donor opacity/ownership or real-image geometry evidence.
Actual all960/2880 denominators, naturalE20 preservation, complete retained-cue join, selected minSHA donor and feature/fullRGB correspondence remain the requested post-seal source certificate audit.
No new training limitation, threshold, model choice or current gate is added.
